why: Not a single reviewer, major or niche, appears; the results are eBay listings, a proxy reseller page, ATOTO and XTRONS brand catalogs, and two blank pages. Only the HIZPO eBay listing (and its iShip mirror) actually meets 6GB + 4G LTE + under $300, and it is a lone product listing with no comparison or testing. The ATOTO pages mostly show over-budget or 4GB units. A focused page comparing qualifying models with chipset, LTE band support, current prices and a clear pick would have no real competition.
